Vantorre Group changed hands on 2026-05-04, a Monday. Moss's Sunday prep from 5/3 says it "changes hands tomorrow, 2026-05-04". His 5/4 digest confirms the account was reassigned in the CRM that day. I replied to you in the DM thread.

Both notes say Gideon Sato took over Vantorre Mobility the same day. The 5/4 digest calls Vantorre Group "Gideon's industrial account", so Gideon presumably has it now too, though that isn't stated outright.
